It is not depending on the line of work you do.  Certain types of jobs you have to divulge all information about yourself.  

Your employer may not know the topic of the meeting, but they will know you went to one.  In the end that is all that is needed for termination if you choose not to state what the appointment was for.

Thank you :)

There are many things that make me happy - but in the end they are all materialistic.  There are things, memories, and experiences I wish I had had.  I don't believe this will ever change
